name: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated
description: A goblet split squat with the front foot on a raised platform. The extra height deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
